expected: Order Reprice-All (Force) on large orders (30+ lines, hundreds of lines) succeeds with no SOQL:101, CPU limit, or 'too many DML' governor error.
actual: Small/mid orders pass (330/453/628 lines: isSuccess=true; SOQL 3-4/100, DML 6-9/150, rows 800-1256/10000). Large orders FAIL: 838 & 847-line reliably, 671-line intermittently -> CANNOT_EXECUTE_FLOW_TRIGGER on 'Fortra | Order | Before Insert/Update - Sync Status'; captured engine log = System.LimitException: Apex CPU time limit exceeded (error.cause=FLOW_INTERVIEW_LIMIT_EXCEEDED), Maximum CPU time 10323->14493 / 10000 ms; SOQL/DML well under limits. 2003-line hits hard RLM cap LIMIT_EXCEEDED 'Too many Order Products'.
defectStep: Save-path before-save flow 'Fortra | Order | Before Insert/Update - Sync Status' re-fires on each RLM place-engine chunk-commit during Reprice-All; cumulative Apex CPU over 10,000ms (engine chunks OrderItem DML in 400/200 batches). Not a V21 pricing-step SOQL/DML blowup (those stay green); CPU is the binding governor.
proposedFix: Bulk-safe the per-chunk Order before-save flow path (Sync Status fires once per engine commit, amplifying CPU); add Is_Split_Line/header-scoped fast-exit; OR raise RLM place chunk granularity / move reprice to async batched context for >~600-line orders. Mirrors SC-3447 P1 (collapse per-line flow CPU) but for reprice not convert. NOT applied (validation-only).
